events.title: EU weighs low-value parcel fee for imported packages
events.content: EU officials are weighing a low-value parcel fee and tariff changes that could raise landed costs for direct-mail cross-border sellers shipping into the European Union.

events.title: EU packaging compliance timeline moves forward
events.content: European Commission officials advanced packaging compliance timelines that may raise packaging and materials costs for sellers shipping consumer goods into the EU.

events.title: Northern Europe congestion delays seller replenishment
events.content: Port congestion across Northern Europe is delaying replenishment and raising delivery-time risk for cross-border sellers relying on imported inventory.

events.title: How Costco and B2B importers are rethinking oil-driven delivery costs
events.content: Costco and other enterprise B2B importers are rethinking oil-driven delivery costs and quarterly planning amid global shipping volatility.

events.title: Oil volatility pressures enterprise import planning
events.content: Global oil volatility is pressuring enterprise import planning and corporate quarterly forecasts across large B2B organizations.
